_**Shake It Up**_ is an American sitcom that originally aired on Disney Channel from November 7, 2010, to November 10, 2013. Created by Chris Thompson and starring Bella Thorne and Zendaya, the show follows the adventures of CeCe Jones (Bella Thorne) and Rocky Blue (Zendaya) as they star as background dancers on a local show, _Shake It Up Chicago_. It also chronicles their misadventures on and off-set and their troubles and rising social status at school. Davis Cleveland, Roshon Fegan, Adam Irigoyen, Kenton Duty and Caroline Sunshine play other main characters in the series. The show's original concept was for Disney to create a female-led buddy comedy with a dance aspect.
On September 29, 2011, Disney Channel announced it had increased _Shake It Up_'s second season order to 26 episodes.[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shake_It_Up_(American_TV_series)#cite_note-1) A 90-minute special episode _Made in Japan_ aired August 17, 2012, as the season two finale.[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shake_It_Up_(American_TV_series)#cite_note-2) On June 4, 2012, Disney Channel announced that _Shake It Up_ was renewed for a third season[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shake_It_Up_(American_TV_series)#cite_note-DCPRS3-3) and announced that Kenton Duty would not be a regular cast member for season 3, but would instead make special guest appearances. Despite this announcement, he did not appear in a single episode.[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shake_It_Up_(American_TV_series)#cite_note-kenton-4)
On July 25, 2013, Disney Channel officially announced that _Shake It Up_ would end its run after three seasons. The final episode aired on November 10, 2013.[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shake_It_Up_(American_TV_series)#cite_note-5)

_Shake It Up_ follows the adventures of best friends CeCe Jones (Bella Thorne) and Rocky Blue (Zendaya) who, with the help of Rocky's brother Ty (Roshon Fegan) and his best friend Deuce Martinez (Adam Irigoyen), fulfill their dreams of becoming professional dancers when they land roles as dancers on a local show "Shake It Up, Chicago!".[[6]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shake_It_Up_(American_TV_series)#cite_note-TVBY1-6) CeCe and Rocky must deal with their new circumstances while balancing maintaining their social status at school, watching CeCe's little brother, Flynn (Davis Cleveland), and the antics of their TV show which include matching the skills of their competition, notably brother and sister duo Gunther and Tinka (Kenton Duty and Caroline Sunshine).[[6]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shake_It_Up_(American_TV_series)#cite_note-TVBY1-6) The show also has storylines which include Ty, who also has dance and rapping skills.[[6]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shake_It_Up_(American_TV_series)#cite_note-TVBY1-6) Singer and fellow Disney alum Selena Gomez performs the theme song, "Shake It Up", which was featured on the _Shake It Up: Break It Down_ soundtrack.

*   Kenton Duty as Gunther Hessenheffer (seasons 1–2)  
*   Caroline Sunshine as Tinka Hessenheffer

The show was ordered up as Disney's attempt at its first show starring two female friends as lead characters, but with a dance-driven aspect.[[7]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shake_It_Up_(American_TV_series)#cite_note-Kansas-7) Initially carrying the working title _Dance, Dance Chicago_, the original description was described as the journey of two kids on a contemporary _American Bandstand_-type show.[[8]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shake_It_Up_(American_TV_series)#cite_note-Andreeva-8) Veteran television producers Chris Thompson, a former writer for _Laverne & Shirley_ and co-creator of _Bosom Buddies_ and Rob Lotterstein, who had worked on several series including _Boy Meets World_ were assigned to work on the story.[[6]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shake_It_Up_(American_TV_series)#cite_note-TVBY1-6)[[9]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shake_It_Up_(American_TV_series)#cite_note-EW-9) Casting for the show began in October 2009.[[8]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shake_It_Up_(American_TV_series)#cite_note-Andreeva-8)Bella Thorne and Zendaya were cast as the two female leads, as well as _Camp Rock_ cast member Roshon Fegan in a co-lead role. On May 21, 2010, with the title change revealed as _Shake It Up_, the production for the show was announced to begin in July, and anticipated for a fall 2010 premiere. President of Disney Entertainment, Gary Marsh said the Bella Thorne/Zendaya duo were the most engaging best friends they had seen on the network. On what makes the show different, Marsh said "while buddy comedies have been around since the start of television, ... this is the first time anyone has incorporated dancing into the underlying premise of a sitcom."[[10]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shake_It_Up_(American_TV_series)#cite_note-Futon1-10)

The concept of the show has been noted to be very similar to that of fellow Disney Channel series _Hannah Montana_, and according to The _Sun-Sentinel_, _Shake It Up_ is the same approach with dance.[[11]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shake_It_Up_(American_TV_series)#cite_note-11) Additionally, the show is Disney's third series to have a show-within-a-show following "Silverstone" in _The Famous Jett Jackson_ and "So Random/Mackenzie Falls" in _Sonny with a Chance_. Chuck Barney of the _Contra Costa Times_ said that the show's plots "play out in typical Disney Channel style with uncomplicated story lines, broad humor and moral uplift."[[7]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shake_It_Up_(American_TV_series)#cite_note-Kansas-7) In an interview, Bella Thorne said of the show, "It is about them going through the stuff that teens go through every day. The writing is very realistic. I have gone through most of these problems."[[12]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shake_It_Up_(American_TV_series)#cite_note-Amy-12) Rosero McCoy, a choreographer for _Camp Rock 2: The Final Jam_ was tapped to be a choreographer for the show, along with Claude Racine.[[13]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shake_It_Up_(American_TV_series)#cite_note-Momlogic-13) The series was shot at Los Angeles Center Studios.[[7]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shake_It_Up_(American_TV_series)#cite_note-Kansas-7)

The series succeeds _Hannah Montana_, _Jonas_, _[I'm in the Band](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/I'm\_in\_the\_Band "I'm in the Band")_ and _Phineas and Ferb_ as Disney's latest foray into music-oriented series.[[8]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shake_It_Up_(American_TV_series)#cite_note-Andreeva-8) According to Rick Bently of the _Fresno Bee_, the show's timing was to capitalize off the success of the current dance series' _Dancing with the Stars_ and _So You Think You Can Dance_.[[14]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shake_It_Up_(American_TV_series)#cite_note-Bently-14) Original music for the series has been produced and recorded by the show's cast and various artists, with the theme song "Shake It Up" performed by American singer and actress Selena Gomez.[[15]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shake_It_Up_(American_TV_series)#cite_note-15) The theme was written and produced by Aris Archontis, Jeanne Lurie and Chen Neeman, who also penned the opening title themes to fellow Disney series _Sonny with a Chance_ and _Good Luck Charlie_.
Bella Thorne and Zendaya serve as the series' main central focus duo, CeCe and Rocky.

In initial casting, Disney searched for two female co-leads.[[16]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shake_It_Up_(American_TV_series)#cite_note-Variety-16) Although boasting elaborate credits of prior television experience, including guest starring on _Wizards of Waverly Place_, Bella Thorne was cast after never dancing professionally before, and took dance classes three times a week to improve.[[12]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shake_It_Up_(American_TV_series)#cite_note-Amy-12) Zendaya had theater background prior to her casting, and grew up in theater when her mother worked in the California Shakespeare Theater in Oakland, California.[[16]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shake_It_Up_(American_TV_series)#cite_note-Variety-16) Having the same agent that discovered Miley Cyrus, she won the role after several auditions and over 200 other hopefuls.[[7]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shake_It_Up_(American_TV_series)#cite_note-Kansas-7) On the casting of the two, Judy Taylor, Senior Vice President of Casting for Disney Channel, commented that Zendaya was "completely engaging" with a "great presence" and that Thorne had "high energy" and viewers would "want to get to know her better the instant you meet her."[[16]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shake_It_Up_(American_TV_series)#cite_note-Variety-16) One goal was for the two leads to have chemistry working together, and Thorne said of her relationship with Zendaya, "When we first met, there was this energy. It was like we were meant to be together."[[7]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shake_It_Up_(American_TV_series)#cite_note-Kansas-7)

Title: The Cast of Disney Channel's 'Shake It Up': Where Are They Now?
Chunks: 0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7
The young stars of _Shake It Up_ are all grown up!
The Disney Channel series, which ran from 2010 to 2013, featured Bella Thorne and Zendaya in their breakout roles as aspiring dancers CeCe Jones and Rocky Blue. After successfully auditioning for the fictional, Chicago-based teen dance show _Shake It Up_, they had to navigate the industry and their friendship.
Davis Cleveland, Roshon Fegan, Adam Irigoyen, Kenton Duty and Caroline Sunshine also starred alongside Thorne and Zendaya. Since the show ended after three seasons on Nov. 10, 2013, some of the cast has stayed in the entertainment industry while others have taken a step back — even venturing into politics!
Catch up with the actors of the Disney show more than a decade after they’ve left the dance floor.
01 of 07

## Zendaya as Rocky Blue
(L-R) Zendaya as Rocky Blue and in April 2024.  
Craig Sjodin/Disney Channel via Getty; Kristy Sparow/Getty
Before Zendaya starred in award-winning blockbusters, she was the overachieving Rocky Blue in _Shake It Up_. In 2013, she released a self-titled debut album that included the top 40 hit “Replay.” After _Shake It Up_, she remained with Disney for several years, co-producing and starring in another series, _K.C. Undercover_, from 2015 to 2018. She became a bonafide movie star with a leading role in 2017’s _Spider-Man: Homecoming_, helping her transition from Disney alum to the silver screen.
Her breakthrough role came in 2019 with the teen drama _Euphoria_, which she led and executive produced. As Rue, a struggling teen addict, her performance won her two Emmy Awards for outstanding lead actress in a drama series. The _Malcolm & Marie_ actress also reprised her role for two more _Spider-Man_ films and played Chani in the sci-fi smash hit _Dune_ and its sequel, opposite Timothée Chalamet.
Most recently, Zendaya appeared alongside Mike Faist and Josh O’Connor in Luca Guadagnino’s tennis romance drama _Challengers_.
She is currently in a relationship with _Spider-Man_ costar Tom Holland, whom she has dated since 2021.
02 of 07

## Bella Thorne as CeCe Jones
(L-R) Bella Thorne as CeCe Jones and in September 2021.  
Craig Sjodin/Disney Channel/Getty: Marilla Sicilia/Archivio Marilla Sicilia/Mondadori Portfolio/Getty
Of the lead duo, Bella Thorne played the headstrong, street-smart CeCe Jones. She then booked significant roles in feature films like Adam Sandler and Drew Barrymore’s _Blended_ and the teen comedy _The DUFF_. The actress also led the Freeform drama series _Famous in Love_ from 2017 to 2018. In addition to her acting career, Thorne made a brief foray into singing, releasing the solo EP _Jersey_ in 2014.
Thorne made her directorial debut in 2019 with the adult film _Her & Him_. She will direct her first feature with the film _Color Your Hurt_, based on a true story about a gay man growing up in the Bible Belt. The film will be based on her original screenplay and her short film _Unsettled_, which debuted at the 2024 Palm Springs International Film Festival.
Her next role is set for the upcoming comedy horror _Saint Clare_ with Ryan Phillippe and Rebecca De Mornay.
In May 2023, Thorne announced that she was engaged to entrepreneur and film producer Matt Emms.
03 of 07

## Davis Cleveland as Flynn Jones
(L-R) Davis Cleveland as Flynn Jones and in November 2023.  
Craig Sjodin/Disney Channel via Getty; Davis Cleveland/Instagram
Davis Cleveland landed his first leading role at age 8, playing Flynn, CeCe’s mischievous younger brother. During his Disney Channel run, the child star also appeared in other shows on the network like _Zeke and Luther_, _Hannah Montana_, _Pair of Kings_ and _Good Luck Charlie_. In 2016, he landed a leading role in the Nickelodeon original movie _Rufus_ and its sequel _Rufus 2_.
Cleveland stepped away from the entertainment industry to pursue a degree in psychology with a biology and neurology minor at Texas A&M University. He graduated from undergrad in 2024 and will attend Texas A&M University School of Dentistry.
04 of 07

## Roshon Fegan as Ty Blue
(L-R) Roshon Fegan as Ty Blue and in October 2023.  
Bob D'Amico/Disney Channel via Getty; Axelle/Bauer-Griffin/FilmMagic
Roshon Fegan, who’s also known for the Disney Channel movie _Camp Rock_, portrayed Rocky’s flirty older brother Ty. On season 14 of _Dancing with the Stars_, Fegan partnered up with pro Chelsie Hightower to make a run to the top six.
In 2019, he led the TV biopic _The Bobby DeBarge Story_ as the Motown star. Fegan also founded the clothing brand, record label and media company ICONOMOUS in 2022.
05 of 07

## Adam Irigoyen as Deuce Martinez
(L-R) Adam Irigoyen as Deuce Martinez and in April 2023.  
Craig Sjodin/Disney Channel via Getty; Paul Archuleta/Getty
Adam Irigoyen, who had made his Disney Channel debut on _Wizards of Waverly Place_ in 2009, landed the role of the resourceful Deuce Martinez, Ty’s best friend. Since _Shake It Up_, the actor has had minor roles in several shows, such as _The Fosters_, the TNT drama _The Last Ship_ starring Eric Dane and a guest appearance in Zendaya’s _K.C. Undercover_. His latest project was the Western film _Centurion: The Dancing Stallion_ in 2023.
06 of 07

## Kenton Duty as Gunther Hessenheffer
(L-R) Kenton Duty as Gunther Hessenheffer and in October 2018.  
Bob D'Amico/Disney Channel via Getty; Michael Tullberg/Getty
Kenton Duty is best known for his role as European exchange student Gunther Hessenheffer, who — along with his sister Tinka — becomes CeCe and Rocky’s dance rival. He departed from the series after season 2 and starred in the anti-bullying movie _Contest_.
The former _Lost_ star has had a few one-episode guest spots in shows like _Fresh Off the Boat_ and a recurring role on the short-lived soap _Hilton Head Island_. In 2022, he appeared in the thriller _The Nameless_.
Duty married his longtime girlfriend, writer Mosley Agin, on July 1, 2019. The couple held a separate ceremony with loved ones on September 28, 2019.
07 of 07

## Caroline Sunshine as Tinka Hessenheffer
(L-R) Caroline Sunshine as Tinka Hessenheffer and in April 2018.  
Bob D'Amico/Disney Channel via Getty; Paul Morigi/WireImage
Although Caroline Sunshine retired from acting in 2017, Disney fans will remember her as Gunther’s twin sister and the protagonists’ frenemy Tinka Hessenheffer. Sunshine graduated from Claremont McKenna College, where she studied international relations and economics.
During the Trump administration, the former child star served as a White House intern and later became a full-time press assistant. In February 2023, she became the press secretary and communications director for Indiana gubernatorial candidate Eric Doden, and later that year, she was asked to be press secretary for Vivek Ramaswamy’s presidential campaign.
In June 2024, former President Donald Trump rehired Sunshine as the deputy communications director for his 2024 presidential campaign.

The young stars of _Shake It Up_ are all grown up!
The Disney Channel series, which ran from 2010 to 2013, featured Bella Thorne and Zendaya in their breakout roles as aspiring dancers CeCe Jones and Rocky Blue. After successfully auditioning for the fictional, Chicago-based teen dance show _Shake It Up_, they had to navigate the industry and their friendship.
Davis Cleveland, Roshon Fegan, Adam Irigoyen, Kenton Duty and Caroline Sunshine also starred alongside Thorne and Zendaya. Since the show ended after three seasons on Nov. 10, 2013, some of the cast has stayed in the entertainment industry while others have taken a step back — even venturing into politics!
Catch up with the actors of the Disney show more than a decade after they’ve left the dance floor.

## Zendaya as Rocky Blue
(L-R) Zendaya as Rocky Blue and in April 2024.  
Craig Sjodin/Disney Channel via Getty; Kristy Sparow/Getty
Before Zendaya starred in award-winning blockbusters, she was the overachieving Rocky Blue in _Shake It Up_. In 2013, she released a self-titled debut album that included the top 40 hit “Replay.” After _Shake It Up_, she remained with Disney for several years, co-producing and starring in another series, _K.C. Undercover_, from 2015 to 2018. She became a bonafide movie star with a leading role in 2017’s _Spider-Man: Homecoming_, helping her transition from Disney alum to the silver screen.
Her breakthrough role came in 2019 with the teen drama _Euphoria_, which she led and executive produced. As Rue, a struggling teen addict, her performance won her two Emmy Awards for outstanding lead actress in a drama series. The _Malcolm & Marie_ actress also reprised her role for two more _Spider-Man_ films and played Chani in the sci-fi smash hit _Dune_ and its sequel, opposite Timothée Chalamet.
Most recently, Zendaya appeared alongside Mike Faist and Josh O’Connor in Luca Guadagnino’s tennis romance drama _Challengers_.
She is currently in a relationship with _Spider-Man_ costar Tom Holland, whom she has dated since 2021.

During the Trump administration, the former child star served as a White House intern and later became a full-time press assistant. In February 2023, she became the press secretary and communications director for Indiana gubernatorial candidate Eric Doden, and later that year, she was asked to be press secretary for Vivek Ramaswamy’s presidential campaign.

_**Shake It Up**_ is an American sitcom that originally aired on Disney Channel from November 7, 2010, to November 10, 2013. Created by Chris Thompson and starring Bella Thorne and Zendaya, the show follows the adventures of CeCe Jones (Bella Thorne) and Rocky Blue (Zendaya) as they star as background dancers on a local show, _Shake It Up Chicago_. It also chronicles their misadventures on and off-set and their troubles and rising social status at school. Davis Cleveland, Roshon Fegan, Adam Irigoyen, Kenton Duty and Caroline Sunshine play other main characters in the series. The show's original concept was for Disney to create a female-led buddy comedy with a dance aspect.
On September 29, 2011, Disney Channel announced it had increased _Shake It Up_'s second season order to 26 episodes.[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shake_It_Up_(American_TV_series)#cite_note-1) A 90-minute special episode _Made in Japan_ aired August 17, 2012, as the season two finale.[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shake_It_Up_(American_TV_series)#cite_note-2) On June 4, 2012, Disney Channel announced that _Shake It Up_ was renewed for a third season[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shake_It_Up_(American_TV_series)#cite_note-DCPRS3-3) and announced that Kenton Duty would not be a regular cast member for season 3, but would instead make special guest appearances. Despite this announcement, he did not appear in a single episode.[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shake_It_Up_(American_TV_series)#cite_note-kenton-4)
On July 25, 2013, Disney Channel officially announced that _Shake It Up_ would end its run after three seasons. The final episode aired on November 10, 2013.[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shake_It_Up_(American_TV_series)#cite_note-5)

texts.3: The show was ordered up as Disney's attempt at its first show starring two female friends as lead characters, but with a dance-driven aspect.[[7]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shake_It_Up_(American_TV_series)#cite_note-Kansas-7) Initially carrying the working title _Dance, Dance Chicago_, the original description was described as the journey of two kids on a contemporary _American Bandstand_-type show.[[8]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shake_It_Up_(American_TV_series)#cite_note-Andreeva-8) Veteran television producers Chris Thompson, a former writer for _Laverne & Shirley_ and co-creator of _Bosom Buddies_ and Rob Lotterstein, who had worked on several series including _Boy Meets World_ were assigned to work on the story.[[6]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shake_It_Up_(American_TV_series)#cite_note-TVBY1-6)[[9]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shake_It_Up_(American_TV_series)#cite_note-EW-9) Casting for the show began in October 2009.[[8]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shake_It_Up_(American_TV_series)#cite_note-Andreeva-8)Bella Thorne and Zendaya were cast as the two female leads, as well as _Camp Rock_ cast member Roshon Fegan in a co-lead role. On May 21, 2010, with the title change revealed as _Shake It Up_, the production for the show was announced to begin in July, and anticipated for a fall 2010 premiere. President of Disney Entertainment, Gary Marsh said the Bella Thorne/Zendaya duo were the most engaging best friends they had seen on the network. On what makes the show different, Marsh said "while buddy comedies have been around since the start of television, ... this is the first time anyone has incorporated dancing into the underlying premise of a sitcom."[[10]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shake_It_Up_(American_TV_series)#cite_note-Futon1-10)
texts.4: The concept of the show has been noted to be very similar to that of fellow Disney Channel series _Hannah Montana_, and according to The _Sun-Sentinel_, _Shake It Up_ is the same approach with dance.[[11]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shake_It_Up_(American_TV_series)#cite_note-11) Additionally, the show is Disney's third series to have a show-within-a-show following "Silverstone" in _The Famous Jett Jackson_ and "So Random/Mackenzie Falls" in _Sonny with a Chance_. Chuck Barney of the _Contra Costa Times_ said that the show's plots "play out in typical Disney Channel style with uncomplicated story lines, broad humor and moral uplift."[[7]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shake_It_Up_(American_TV_series)#cite_note-Kansas-7) In an interview, Bella Thorne said of the show, "It is about them going through the stuff that teens go through every day. The writing is very realistic. I have gone through most of these problems."[[12]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shake_It_Up_(American_TV_series)#cite_note-Amy-12) Rosero McCoy, a choreographer for _Camp Rock 2: The Final Jam_ was tapped to be a choreographer for the show, along with Claude Racine.[[13]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shake_It_Up_(American_TV_series)#cite_note-Momlogic-13) The series was shot at Los Angeles Center Studios.[[7]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shake_It_Up_(American_TV_series)#cite_note-Kansas-7)

All my songs are very different from each other. **Annabella Avery Thorne** (born October 8, 1997) is an American actress, singer, and writer. She first received recognition for her roles as Margaux Darling in the series _Dirty Sexy Money_ (2007–2008) and as Ruthy Spivey in the drama series _My Own Worst Enemy_ (2009), the latter of which earned her a Young Artist Award.
Thorne gained prominence for her role as CeCe Jones on the Disney Channel series _Shake It Up_ (2010–2013), for which she received several awards and nominations, including winning an Imagen Award.[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bella_Thorne#cite_note-2) Thorne has since appeared in numerous feature films, including _Blended_ (2014), _Alvin and the Chipmunks: The Road Chip_ (2015), _The Babysitter_ and its sequel (2017–2020). She received praise for her roles in _The DUFF_ (2015), _Amityville: The Awakening_ (2017), and _Infamous_ (2020). Thorne also led the drama series _Famous in Love_ (2017–2018), for which she received nominations from the Teen Choice Awards.

Annabella Avery Thorne[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bella_Thorne#cite_note-AllMusic_Bio-3) was born on October 8, 1997, in Pembroke Pines, Florida,[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bella_Thorne#cite_note-UPI-1)[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bella_Thorne#cite_note-Allmusic-4)[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bella_Thorne#cite_note-Chase's_p502-5) the daughter of Tamara Thorne and Delancey Reinaldo "Rey" Thorne.[[6]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bella_Thorne#cite_note-Disney_Channel_Medianet-6)[[7]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bella_Thorne#cite_note-7) She has three siblings who are also actors.[[6]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bella_Thorne#cite_note-Disney_Channel_Medianet-6)[[8]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bella_Thorne#cite_note-TVG-8) Her father, who was of Cuban descent,[[9]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bella_Thorne#cite_note-HuffPo-ShakeItUp-2012-9)[[10]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bella_Thorne#cite_note-InTouchWeekly-AboutDyingAlone-2017-10)[[11]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bella_Thorne#cite_note-USWeekly-AutumnFalls-2014-11) died in a traffic accident in April 2007, when Thorne was nine years old.[[12]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bella_Thorne#cite_note-SunSentinel-Father-Obit-2007-12)[[13]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bella_Thorne#cite_note-MiamiHerald-AutumnFalls-2014-13) She has said that she was raised by a mother who was supporting four children, that they were very poor,

In January 2018, Thorne wrote on Instagram that she had been physically and sexually abused as a child, "from the day I can remember till I was 14".[[20]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bella_Thorne#cite_note-20) In 2019, she told ABC News' Juju Chang that the abuse began when she was six years old. She did not name her alleged abuser, but said that he was "someone I was raised with".[[21]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bella_Thorne#cite_note-21)

Thorne's first single, "Watch Me" was released on June 21, reaching 86 on the US _Billboard_ Hot 100 charts,[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bella_Thorne#cite_note-Allmusic-4) 9 on the US Top Heatseekers charts[[28]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bella_Thorne#cite_note-28) and earning RIAA: Gold.[[29]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bella_Thorne#cite_note-29) On September 29, 2011, Disney Channel announced it had increased _Shake It Up_'s second season order to 26 episodes.[[30]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bella_Thorne#cite_note-30) A 90-minute special episode _Made In Japan_ aired August 17, 2012, as the season two finale.[[31]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bella_Thorne#cite_note-31) On June 4, 2012, Disney Channel announced that _Shake It Up_ had been renewed for a third season.[[32]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bella_Thorne#cite_note-DCPRS3-32) In 2012, Thorne was cast as Avalon Greene in the Disney Channel Original Movie_Frenemies_.[[33]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bella_Thorne#cite_note-33) "TTYLXOX" was released on March 6, reaching 97 on the US _Billboard_ Hot 100 charts.[[34]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bella_Thorne#cite_note-bill-34) On March 30, 2013, it was confirmed by Hollywood Records via Twitter that Thorne had officially signed to the record label.[[35]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bella_Thorne#cite_note-35)
